s: December 6, 2025 - Life insurance for young adults protects parents, partners, or co-signers from debts and expenses if something unexpected happens during this time. By purchasing life insurance early, you lower the risk of facing rejection or expensive premiums later in life due to health issues or lifestyle changes. Whether you choose term, whole, or universal life, early life insurance coverage supports future goals like buying a home, starting a family, or growing a business.
